checkpoint: best.pt selected solely by the frozen training_val proxy; no debug-based selection

model.source: two independent CPU loads of the identical verified saved checkpoint
model.reference: saved fp16 EMA converted to CUDA FP32
model.comparison: same saved fp16 EMA converted to CUDA FP16

preprocessing.decode: cv2.imdecode color BGR, EXIF orientation ignored; dimensions checked against source manifest
preprocessing.letterbox: Ultralytics LetterBox 640x640, auto=False, scale_fill=False, scaleup=True, center=True, stride=32, value=114, INTER_LINEAR
preprocessing.input: BGR to RGB, CHW contiguous; shared FP32 uint8/255 normalization; FP16 input is that FP32 tensor cast to half

raw.layout: [1,14,8400]: first four channels decoded pixel xywh at 640; ten sigmoid class scores; no objectness
raw.comparison: all anchors, channel order retained, FP32 is asymmetric allclose reference
raw.failure_policy: retain FAIL; no tolerance change; finite/shape failure aborts matching

postprocessing.backend: Ultralytics non_max_suppression on CPU FP32 clone, torchvision imported explicitly
postprocessing.time_limit_warning_policy: abort and preserve the attempt; never accept a truncated NMS result
postprocessing.max_det_saturation_policy: report each branch/image reaching 1000, without changing the fixed cap
postprocessing.restore: subtract actual integer left/top padding and divide recorded gain; do not clip before ignore-region filtering
postprocessing.mapping: YOLO class 0..9 maps explicitly to publisher category 1..10

matching.size_scope: all eligible sizes; no small-only metric

limits: The 109 debug images were previously used for engineering work and are not independent Selection or Holdout evidence.
FP32 reference weights are the saved fp16 EMA checkpoint converted to float; original full-precision training weights are not recovered.
Both PyTorch models are unfused and use one fixed preprocessing/postprocessing contract; this is not TensorRT or Orin validation.
Same-backend dtype tolerances are fixed before execution; failure is retained without relaxing thresholds.
Project ignore-aware target matching is not official VisDrone AP and has not been certified against a MATLAB/Octave oracle.
Finite output, target hits, or a dtype guard PASS do not automatically accept a scientific float baseline.
The original Gate0.5 FAILED_UNCHANGED numerical guard is a separate artifact and is never replaced by this check.
